title: 删除子字符串的最大得分
summary: 删除一次 ab 得 x 分、删除一次 ba 得 y 分，字符消失后相邻关系变化，求最大总分。
insight: 两类模式互相竞争时，应先尽可能删除分值较高者，再在剩余字符串删除另一类。固定模式可用栈线性删除所有匹配。
pitfalls: 若 y 更高需先处理 ba
第一次删除后的剩余串仍保持原相对顺序
栈顶与当前字符形成模式时立即消除

solutions.title: 高分模式优先栈消除
solutions.idea: 交换处理顺序后分别做两次确定模式消除。
steps: remove(text,first,second) 用字符栈消除 first+second，返回剩余串与次数
若 x>=y 先 remove ab，再 remove ba；否则反向
两次删除次数乘各自分值后相加

code.java: class Solution { private static class Removal{String text;int count;Removal(String text,int count){this.text=text;this.count=count;}}private Removal remove(String text,char first,char second){StringBuilder stack=new StringBuilder();int count=0;for(char letter:text.toCharArray())if(letter==second&&stack.length()>0&&stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)==first){stack.deleteCharAt(stack.length()-1);count++;}else stack.append(letter);return new Removal(stack.toString(),count);}public int maximumGain(String text,int x,int y){if(x>=y){Removal high=remove(text,'a','b'),low=remove(high.text,'b','a');return high.count*x+low.count*y;}Removal high=remove(text,'b','a'),low=remove(high.text,'a','b');return high.count*y+low.count*x;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun remove(text:String,first:Char,second:Char):Pair<String,Int>{val stack=StringBuilder();var count=0;for(letter in text)if(letter==second&&stack.isNotEmpty()&&stack.last()==first){stack.deleteCharAt(stack.lastIndex);count++}else stack.append(letter);return stack.toString() to count};fun maximumGain(text:String,x:Int,y:Int):Int{if(x>=y){val high=remove(text,'a','b');val low=remove(high.first,'b','a');return high.second*x+low.second*y};val high=remove(text,'b','a');val low=remove(high.first,'a','b');return high.second*y+low.second*x} }
code.cpp: class Solution { pair<string,int> removePattern(string text,char first,char second){string stack;int count=0;for(char letter:text)if(letter==second&&!stack.empty()&&stack.back()==first){stack.pop_back();++count;}else stack+=letter;return {stack,count};}public:int maximumGain(string text,int x,int y){if(x>=y){auto high=removePattern(text,'a','b');auto low=removePattern(high.first,'b','a');return high.second*x+low.second*y;}auto high=removePattern(text,'b','a');auto low=removePattern(high.first,'a','b');return high.second*y+low.second*x;} };
